credibility.summary: Management tends to miss specific operational normalization targets like working capital ranges while delivering strong revenue and margin expansions.

narrative_vs_numbers: Management guided working capital to return to 50-55 days, but actual working capital dropped significantly to 11 days.
Reported consolidated revenue growth reached 53% YoY in Sep 2026, aligning with strong business momentum.
EBITDA margins hovered around 14%, supporting management's medium-term margin guidance.
Capex deployment is ongoing towards multi-year targets with H1 FY27 capex at INR 6.1 billion.
